sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of New Berlin to alienate certain parklands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of New Berlin to discontinue the use as parkland and alienate certain lands.

sponsored.t: Permits the Chenango Forks central school district to create an insurance reserve fund
sponsored.sum: Permits the Chenango Forks central school district to create an insurance reserve fund.

sponsored.t: Requires all sex offenders convicted by the state be placed in the online directory
sponsored.sum: Requires all sex offenders convicted by the state be placed in the online directory; establishes what information shall be required to be disclosed for level one sex offenders.

sponsored.t: Requires financial security for reclamation for solar and wind electric generating systems
sponsored.sum: Requires financial security for reclamation for solar and wind electric generating systems.

sponsored.t: Relates to state police retirement service credit for Michael V. Layman
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Michael V. Layman to receive state police retirement credit for services performed as a SUNY police officer.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of education to develop curriculum for firearm safety classes in schools and provides for schools to be able to provide firearm safety instruction
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to develop curriculum for firearm safety classes in schools; provides for schools to be able to provide firearm safety instruction which can be used to obtain a hunting license.

sponsored.t: Provides that candidates who have provided firefighting service may deduct up to a maximum of six years from their age for purposes of meeting the age requirements
sponsored.sum: Provides that candidates who have provided firefighting service may deduct up to a maximum of six years from their age for purposes of meeting the age requirements.

sponsored.t: Extends the timeframe for motor vehicle inspections for new motor vehicles sold within the state
sponsored.sum: Extends the timeframe for motor vehicle inspections for new motor vehicles sold within the state to five years from the date of sale.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the creation and issuance of a distinctive license plate for fire police
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the creation and issuance of a distinctive license plate for fire police.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing a physically disabled surviving spouse who was married to an enhanced STAR qualifying individual to continue to receive the exemption
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing a physically disabled surviving spouse who was married to an enhanced STAR qualifying individual to continue to receive the exemption even if the surviving spouse is not sixty-two years of age.

sponsored.t: Provides a real property tax exemption to agricultural lands that are used for certain purposes
sponsored.sum: Provides a real property tax exemption to agricultural lands that are used for certain purposes.

sponsored.t: Allows police vehicles to have one or more forward facing blue lights
sponsored.sum: Allows police vehicles to have one or more forward facing blue lights, provided that such blue light can only be displayed in combination with a red and/or white light.

sponsored.t: Prohibits registered sex offenders from using or being within five hundred feet of any state or municipal-owned park
sponsored.sum: Prohibits registered sex offenders from using or being within five hundred feet of any state or municipal-owned park.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a study on the wages earned by aides to the developmentally disabled
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of labor and the office for people with developmental disabilities to study and report on the wages earned by those who help, assist, support, and/or work with the developmentally disabled.

sponsored.t: Creates a tax credit for businesses that develop a "college to work" program, paying the tuition of individuals in exchange for future employment
sponsored.sum: Creates a tax credit for businesses that develop a "college to work" program, paying the tuition of individuals in exchange for the individual committing to work for the business after the individual's graduation from an institution of higher learning; provides the tax credit shall be for twenty-five percent of the individual's tuition expenses not to exceed five thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Allows for counties through their local governing body to elect to participate in a stream maintenance and flood control program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of environmental conservation to establish a stream maintenance and flood control program; allows for the local governing body of a county to elect to pass a local law providing for a local option into such program; provides for the county to be responsible for performing the work outlined in an approved stream maintenance and flood control plan.

sponsored.t: Creates a cellulosic ethanol task force to prevent and reduce the production and emanation of greenhouse gases
sponsored.sum: Creates a cellulosic ethanol task force to prevent and reduce the production and emanation of greenhouse gases.

sponsored.t: Establishes a fire protection and emergency task force in rural areas
sponsored.sum: Establishes a fire prevention and emergency task force to develop a plan for training requirements and standards for fire prevention and emergency response services in rural areas and to examine the necessity of having uniform standards across the state.

sponsored.t: Provides tax credits equal to the cost of the issuance of fishing and hunting licenses to volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers
sponsored.sum: Provides tax credits equal to the cost of the issuance of fishing and hunting licenses to volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers.

sponsored.t: Provides that certified handicapped individuals may use an ATV on public land for transportation purposes only, during the hunting season
sponsored.sum: Provides that certified handicapped individuals may use an ATV on public land for transportation purposes only, during the hunting season.

sponsored.t: Authorizes counties to lease county land for natural gas exploration, development and production for 5 years or as long as gas is produced
sponsored.sum: Authorizes counties to lease county land for natural gas exploration, development and production for five years or as long as gas is produced in paying quantities.

sponsored.t: Establishes guidelines for DAs with regard to electronic conversion of certain records, books or papers in the care or custody of DAs that are more than ten years old
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing guidelines for DAs with regard to electronic conversion of certain records, books or papers in the care, custody or control of DAs that are more than 10 years old.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of environmental conservation to promulgate rules and regulations relating to gas flow meters at natural gas well sites
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of environmental conservation to promulgate rules and regulations relating to gas flow meters at natural gas well sites.

sponsored.t: Establishes an authorized absence from work for certain emergency services volunteers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits an employer from terminating an employee who is also a volunteer firefighter or an enrolled member of a volunteer ambulance service when such employee misses or is late to work because of an emergency to which the employee was dispatched.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of economic development to study methods for keeping small retail businesses within the state and creates pilot program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of economic development to study methods for keeping small retail businesses within the state and create a pilot program to train and counsel small business owners and potential small business owners; appropriates $210,000 therefor.

sponsored.t: Creates the concentrated animal feeding operation environmental compliance revolving loan program
sponsored.sum: Creates the concentrated animal feeding operation environmental compliance revolving loan program.

sponsored.t: Provides for the establishment of a method for determining the lowest responsible bidder when negotiating state contracts
sponsored.sum: Provides for the establishment of a method for determining the lowest responsible bidder when negotiating state contracts that would incorporate quantifiable fiscal benefits.

sponsored.t: Provides for the continuation of a commercial driver's license after lapse or termination of insurance if a person needs such license to perform employment
sponsored.sum: Provides for the continuation of a commercial driver's license after lapse or termination of insurance if a person needs such license to perform their employment.

sponsored.t: Gives state income tax credit to volunteer firefighters and members of a volunteer ambulance corps in good standing up to $2500
sponsored.sum: Gives state income tax credit to volunteer firefighters and members of a volunteer ambulance corps in good standing up to $2500; must be in good standing for a minimum of five years and maintain continued eligibility.

sponsored.t: Provides that before a person may receive public assistance benefits, they must submit to a drug test
sponsored.sum: Provides that before a person may receive public assistance benefits, they must submit to and pass a drug test; requires health care professionals, law enforcement agencies, and courts report certain instances of substance abuse to the commissioner of social services.

sponsored.t: Makes life imprisonment without parole mandatory for defendants convicted of murder in the first degree or second degree and the victim is a police officer, peace officer, first responder or correctional officer
sponsored.sum: Makes life imprisonment without parole mandatory for defendants convicted of murder in the first degree or second degree and the victim is a police officer, peace officer, first responder or correctional officer.

sponsored.t: Relates to vision screening examinations for students
sponsored.sum: Requires vision screening examinations for students using examination devices and testing methods, including, but not limited to, the Snellen Eye Test Chart and automated vision screening devices.

sponsored.t: Relates to minority and women-owned business enterprises in relation to state contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to minority-owned and women-owned business enterprises in relation to state contracts.

sponsored.t: Elevates assault of a code enforcement official to the class D felony of assault in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Elevates assault of a code enforcement official in the second degree to a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing an income tax credit for retired disabled police officers
sponsored.sum: Provides a $750 income tax credit for retired disabled police officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to purchases of ammunition
sponsored.sum: Permits those licensed to carry or possess a pistol or revolver or to purchase or take possession of a semi-automatic rifle or licensed to hunt wildlife to purchase or take possession of ammunition without requiring contacting the statewide license and record database.

sponsored.t: Repeals provision of vehicle and traffic law relating to periodic inspections of police vehicles
sponsored.sum: Relates to periodic inspections of police vehicles; removes exemption for police vehicles for periodic inspections.

sponsored.t: Waives a registration fee for basic life support first response agencies
sponsored.sum: Relates to waiving the $200 microscopy registration fee for basic life support first response agencies.

sponsored.t: Subject to an appropriation for the 2027-2028 state fiscal year, provides that farmers shall receive an exemption from tolls when transporting products to the city of New York for consumption in such city
sponsored.sum: Provides that farmers shall receive an exemption from tolls when transporting products to the city of New York for consumption in such city, subject to an appropriation for the 2027-28 state fiscal year.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the geographical area of employment of university police officers; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to expanding the geographical area of employment of university police officers; extends the jurisdiction of New York state university police officers from state university of New York property and abutting roadways to all areas of the state.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Protecting Religious Assembly in States of Emergency (PRAISE) Act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the Protecting Religious Assembly in States of Emergency (PRAISE) Act; prohibits any governmental entity from discriminating against and closing a place of worship during an emergency.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of money a public retirement system retiree may earn in a position of public service to $100,000
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of money a public retirement system retiree may earn in a position of public service in the year 2025 and thereafter to $100,000.

sponsored.t: Relates to the operation of vehicles on approach of authorized emergency vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires drivers to create a center rescue lane on approach of authorized emergency vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to the crime of criminal trespass in the third degree
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person is guilty of criminal trespass in the third degree if such person is in any portion of this state after entering the state at any location other than a lawful port of entry or border crossing.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting supervised injection sites
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting supervised injection sites; provides that it shall be unlawful for any person to own, operate, work in or volunteer at a supervised injection site; defines terms and establishes penalties.

sponsored.t: Permits the possession and use of firearm silencers for bolt action rifles
sponsored.sum: Permits the possession and use of devices that silence, suppress, or muffle the sound or natural report of a firearm when the firearm is discharged, provided the host firearm to which the device is attached is allowed and is a rifle that is manually operated by a bolt.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Dickinson to establish hotel and motel taxes within such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Dickinson to establish hotel and motel taxes within such town.

sponsored.t: Extends the mortgage recording tax for Chenango county and relates to the depositing of mortgage recording tax funds into the general fund of the county of Chenango
sponsored.sum: Extends the mortgage recording tax for Chenango county; relates to the depositing of mortgage recording tax funds into the general fund of the county of Chenango.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to "Trooper Jill E. Mattice"
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Morris, county of Otsego, to Trooper Jill E. Mattice.
